import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

reference_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_124\B2F modified_res.xlsx"
predicted_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_124\B2F modified.xlsx"

# Load and restructure reference
ref_df_raw = pd.read_excel(reference_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')
years = [col for col in ref_df_raw.columns if col != 'Year']
fertilizers = ref_df_raw.iloc[0, 1:].tolist()
values = ref_df_raw.iloc[1, 1:].tolist()

# Parse years - extract base year from entries like "2024.1" -> 2024
parsed_years = []
for y in years:
    if isinstance(y, str):
        # Extract numeric part before decimal
        base_year = int(float(y.split('.')[0]))
    else:
        base_year = int(y)
    parsed_years.append(base_year)

# Create long format with parsed years
data_list = []
for i in range(len(years)):
    data_list.append({
        'Year': parsed_years[i],
        'Fertilizer': fertilizers[i],
        'Value': values[i]
    })

df_long = pd.DataFrame(data_list)

print("=== REFERENCE PIVOTED (expected structure) ===")

print()

# Load predicted

print("=== PREDICTED FILE ===")
print(pred_df)
print(f"Shape: {pred_df.shape}")
